audience: agencies and service teams who run client work in Accelo

useCases.title: Check the status of client projects
useCases.text: The AI lists Accelo jobs (projects) for a company and opens single jobs for details. You get a short summary of each project.

useCases.title: Find which invoices clients still owe
useCases.text: The AI lists invoices with Accelo filters and opens single ones. It adds up what each client company has not paid yet.

useCases.title: Summarize the sales pipeline
useCases.text: The AI lists prospects (sales opportunities) and opens single ones for details. You get an overview of the deals now in the pipeline.

useCases.title: Review open support tickets
useCases.text: The AI lists issues (support tickets) and opens single ones. It groups them so you see which clients have the most open tickets.

useCases.title: Add a task or log an activity
useCases.text: The AI creates a task against a job or company, or logs a note, email, call or meeting activity on it.

useCases.title: Look up or add a company and contact
useCases.text: The AI searches companies and contacts, and creates a new company or a new contact when none exists.
